item.title: Samsung Gets FDA Clearance for Hearing‑Aid on Buds
item.description: Samsung’s FDA‑cleared hearing‑aid mode for Galaxy Buds 3 Pro and 4 Pro provides OTC sound amplification, a five‑minute medical‑grade hearing test, and syncs results to Samsung Health.
